svg.title: How grade_generation checks an answer in two stages. Stage 1, the hallucination grader: is everything in the answer supported by the documents? No: "not supported", write the answer again. In my run the first tiramisu answer said it "comes from Italy" and was sent back. Yes: stage 2, the answer grader: does it answer the question? No: "not useful", reword the question and search again. Yes: "useful", done.
